task: Predict whether a person's annual income exceeds $50,000, from the 1994 US census.
dataset_description: Age, work class, fnlwgt (the census sampling weight), education and years of education, marital status, occupation, relationship in the household, race, sex, capital gain and loss, hours worked per week. 'column=value' columns are one-hot categories; sex is 1 for its second value.
